prompt:
Use case: ui-mockup / stylized-concept.
Create one polished ideal ART DIRECTION image for a Chinese cultivation game's programmable formation disk, by populating the provided EMPTY DISK reference. This is a cohesive finished concept illustration, not a screenshot, not an exploded asset sheet.

VIEW AND COMPOSITION: absolute 90-degree orthographic top-down view, like inspecting the top face of a CPU motherboard under a camera. Preserve the reference disk's circular outline and precise dark blue-black ceramic/jade substrate, thin aged copper rim and subtle manufacturing details. Show the entire disk nearly filling a square image, with a small transparent margin. Only top faces and very fine bevels are visible, no isometric perspective, no tilted tabletop or thick visible side walls.

DESIGN LANGUAGE: “修仙阵机电路板” — an ancient precision-engineered spiritual circuit board. Sophisticated miniature ceramic/copper packages, tiny contacts, fine cover plates, copper ribs, micro rivets, milky jade cores. Restrained hand-painted ink-and-color game art, crisp industrial craftsmanship translated into East Asian fantasy materials. Dark ceramic, soft smoky white nephrite, warm muted red copper. Complete functional devices, not broken rocks, jewelry, ordinary tools or modern plastic PC components.

Populate the disk with FOUR clearly different integrated packages arranged with intentional breathing room and organized routing:
1) upper-left: a compact sensing package with three small copper lamellae around a milky needle core, a precise small dark ceramic housing and short contact feet. Not a target/crosshair icon.
2) central slightly left: a larger octagonal formation-eye controller package, similar in visual sophistication to a custom CPU. A quiet square white jade core, layered ceramic cover, tiny copper contacts around its rim and subtle etched inner construction. Not a steering wheel, eyeball or ornamental gem.
3) lower-left: a horizontal elongated energy-source package with one contained strip of smoky white spirit marrow, restrained by fine copper ribs and a fitted dark ceramic/copper cover. A single complete engineered component, not two jewels or a battery pictogram.
4) right-middle: a vertical elongated protective ACTUATOR package with TWO nested opposing curved copper/ceramic ribs over an open central slit, a compact precisely assembled power-module silhouette with tiny contact pads. It MUST NOT look like a shield, shield emblem, armor plate, weapon or bow. The two-arc structure is abstract functional hardware.

CIRCUIT TRACES ARE A MAIN FOCUS, NOT AN AFTERTHOUGHT. Include two distinct beautifully resolved planar trace systems:
- fine, muted cinnabar-red copper signal traces: hairline etched channels, subtle mineral-ink texture and minute solder-pad terminations;
- slightly broader pale smoky teal-white spirit-energy traces: a precise flat conductor with a finely luminous inlaid core and delicate copper binding/contact details, softly glowing but never neon.
Every visible main route must join a believable contact on a component. Lay out clean paths with generous separation, continuous small-radius fillets or precise 45-degree beveled turns. Trace width, edge texture and lighting remain continuous through bends: no dark triangular wedges, overlapping strip joins, thick black outlines, blocky elbows, plumbing pipes or flat UI color ribbons. No wire crossings, bridges, spaghetti, fake glowing halos or uncontrolled branching. The main signal route runs from the upper-left sensor across the upper working face and enters the top of the right-hand actuator. The energy route leaves the lower-left source, follows the lower working face and enters the actuator from below. Small local manufacturing contacts and delicate internal details within each package can provide motherboard richness, but keep the two main routes readable.

IDLE STATE: no square grid, checkerboard, coordinate lines, cell outlines, selection rectangles, arrows, UI ports, toolbars, labels or numbers. The 4x4 layout is an INVISIBLE organizing constraint, not a drawn chessboard. This must feel like one integrated handcrafted circuit artifact, rather than loose icons pasted on a background.
Lighting is unified soft overhead studio light, shallow contact shadows only, no dramatic cast shadows or external glow. Keep the painted surface tactile and quiet, components visibly lighter than the substrate and readable at game scale. True transparency outside the disk. No text or watermark.
